name: Prince Malchezaar's Enfeeble does not restore a stale earlier-wave health (#8319)
contract: Enfeeble (30843) captures each enfeebled raider's health and restores it 9 seconds later.
boss_malchezaar is registered through RegisterKarazhanCreatureAI/GetInstanceAI, so its real script
(including the Enfeeble bug) only runs on the real Karazhan spawn (creature guid 135477, map 532,
InstanceScript, not on a fixture copy summoned in the open world. A raider enfeebled in the first wave,
then moved out of Enfeeble's 200-yard radius (SpellRadius 22) and given a different health before the
second wave casts, keeps that later health instead of being silently reset to the first wave's stale
captured value 9 seconds after the second cast.

steps.label: Let login settle
raider joins the tank's group, so both bind to the same Karazhan instance
tank sees the real Karazhan spawns
raider sees the real Karazhan spawns
tank enters the real Karazhan at Prince Malchezaar's chamber
SETUP: tank is in Karazhan
raider enters far from the chamber, out of melee/AOE range, to avoid incidental damage before the first wave
SETUP: raider is in Karazhan
SETUP: the real Prince Malchezaar spawn stands in his chamber
SETUP: Malchezaar is undamaged, so the instance is fresh
SETUP: nobody pulled Malchezaar before the encounter
Tank survives the whole encounter
Engage the real Prince Malchezaar so his Enfeeble schedule starts
SETUP: Malchezaar engages
Keep the raider out of incidental raid damage until just before the scheduled +30s Enfeeble cast
Bring the raider into Enfeeble's radius only now, right before the cast
Known, uncontaminated baseline health for Enfeeble's capture
SETUP: the first wave's Enfeeble cast happens
Move the raider to safety right after being captured; same map, so the scripted reset 9s later still finds and restores them
Survive out of combat; the scripted reset restores the stored 100000 regardless of this
Cross wave 1's own 9s-later reset
SETUP: wave 1's own reset restores the raider's captured health
Give the raider a health value wave 1's stale capture (100000) would not produce; still out of Enfeeble's 200-yard radius for wave 2
SETUP: the second wave's Enfeeble cast happens (the raider is out of range)
Cross wave 2's 9s-later reset
DISCRIMINATING: the raider's deliberately set health survives wave 2's reset untouched
The tank survived the encounter
